cards.card_text: Then the angel of the LORD comes and sits under the oak in Ophrah that belongs to Joash the Abiezrite.
cards.verse_text: Then the angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites.
cards.snippet: …sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide…

cards.card_text: It was still standing in Ophrah of the Abiezrites when this was written.
cards.verse_text: To this day it stands in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
cards.snippet: To this day it stands in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

cards.card_text: Gideon blows the ram's horn, and the Abiezrites, his father Joash's people (Judges 6:11), rally behind him.
cards.verse_text: So the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, who blew the ram’s horn and rallied the Abiezrites behind him.
cards.snippet: …LORD came upon Gideon, who blew the ram’s horn and rallied the Abiezrites behind him.
